record.body: No realized RevenueFROMCustomer or RevenueFORCustomer delta is attributed to this run. R78 improves the lawful selection path feeding structural/RevOps manufacture by making repository-universe and ready-set GGEN projections deterministic. RevOps remains downstream: exact R78 qualification -> R76/R74 revalidation -> deterministic structural option manufacture -> consumers -> qualification receipts -> payer/beneficiary/value-outcome attribution. RevenueFROMCustomer remains distinct from RevenueFORCustomer; neither is inferred from manufacturing activity alone.
